selected_evidence.requirement: inventory-api deployed as a managed (systemd) service
selected_evidence.summary: systemd unit created, enabled, and started; service reports active with MainPID and OOMScoreAdjust=-1000
inventory-api's oom_score_adj confirmed as -1000 in /proc, /health and /inventory endpoints return valid JSON over $NODE_IP, and dmesg shows no prior OOM kills

selected_evidence.requirement: Memory-hungry process drives system out of memory
selected_evidence.summary: hog.py launched and grew to ~1.5GB RSS on a 1.7GiB-RAM node, exhausting available memory

selected_evidence.requirement: Kernel OOM killer stops the memory hog, not inventory-api
selected_evidence.summary: dmesg shows 'Out of memory: Killed process 2505 (python3) ... oom_score_adj:0' -- the unprotected hog process, pid 2505 -- while inventory-api (pid 2445, oom_score_adj:-1000) is absent from the kill and still listed as running in the same dmesg process table dump

selected_evidence.requirement: inventory-api keeps serving through and after the OOM event
selected_evidence.summary: Post-OOM check: systemctl is-active=active, same PID 2445 (never restarted), /health and /inventory both return correct JSON via $NODE_IP

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: healthy baseline boot identity capture
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id be303eb3-eeb6-4466-86f1-fd6406dd7dad and machine-id via /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: acknowledgement returns before disconnect, node restarted one at a time
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued in background with disown; exec stream closed as node went down, confirming the reboot command executed

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: poll until exec available again and boot identity changed
selected_evidence.summary: Polling shows connection timeout, then reset, then success; post-restart boot_id is 58cc4b95-4da2-45ed-bbe6-2f91c6d8ce7b (changed from baseline) and uptime shows 0 minutes, proving an actual reboot occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: post-restart recovery of required service and data
selected_evidence.summary: inventory-api is active/enabled post-reboot with OOMScoreAdjust=-1000 preserved via the unit file, and /health plus /inventory (with original data intact) respond correctly over $NODE_IP
